policy.purpose: Measure open-world generalization without adding prompt-specific source aliases or workload hardware floors.
policy.holdout_use: Certification only; do not tune routing, queries, parsers, or ranking against individual failures.

visible_development.prompt: I want Minecraft to look almost photorealistic with a huge modpack.
I edit wedding films and do not want exports running overnight.
I make music with very large sample libraries and need it quiet on stage.
I want to scan rooms and turn them into explorable 3D environments.
This must be officially supported for five years and work with our Linux fleet.
Only configurations in the vendor's certified hardware matrix are acceptable.
It needs two external 6K displays through one dock, but I cannot install proprietary drivers.
Exclude anything with an unresolved critical firmware advisory.

sealed_holdout.prompt: I need a portable system for processing terrestrial LiDAR scans and registering billion-point surveys.
Can this laptop run a coupled FEA and CFD workflow? Only configurations certified by the solver vendor are acceptable.
I need something mobile for basecalling nanopore sequencing data in the field.
We analyse cryo-electron microscopy data locally before uploading it.
I need to reconstruct drone imagery into georeferenced orthomosaics and dense meshes.
Can I simulate robotic surgery force feedback and stereo vision locally?
I need a machine for computational chemistry and molecular-dynamics experiments, but I do not know which stages require a GPU.
We train anomaly-detection models from vibration sensors on mining equipment while offline.
Could this notebook process hyperspectral crop images at a remote field station without cloud access?
I need to align and inspect whole-slide pathology images while travelling between hospitals.
Will this handle real-time acoustic beamforming from a large microphone array?
We need local reconstruction of subsurface radar scans where internet access is intermittent.

category_boundaries.prompt: I need a standing desk for a photogrammetry workstation.
Recommend an ultrasound machine for a rural clinic.
We need laboratory refrigerators with remote monitoring.
Find ergonomic seating for an engineer who works with point clouds.

metamorphic_templates.transform: make mobility optional and cloud acceptable
change exact certification from required to preferred
